tourism.metric: OSM snapshot counts within 800m of station; badge hotels >=50 or attractions >=8

michelin.metric: stars -> michelin_stars; bib_gourmand -> michelin_bib; retain stored district aggregates

embassy.metric: legacy embassies_800m; district-center field per scripts/institutions/README.md; original calculation/center not independently established
embassy.provenance_gap: Exact values retained from baseline commit. Not embassies_inside_district; no claim these are current observations.

institutions.metric: embassies_inside_district and embassies_within_800m (station anchors); not the legacy district embassies_800m field

retained_population.dataset: WorldPop Global1 constrained individual countries 2020 / BSGM / THA
retained_population.attribution: WorldPop, University of Southampton. Bondarenko M., Kerr D., Sorichetta A. and Tatem A.J. (2020). Constrained BSGM census/projection-disaggregated population. Adapted by City Rating: district aggregation and density scoring.
retained_population.method: Sum original float counts in pixel-center masks of published OSM district polygons, excluding holes; divide by official district area. NoData contributes zero; no pixel-area multiplier, reprojection or resampling of population counts.
